svg.data-projection: Albers equal-area, central meridian 82° E, standard parallels 12° and 32° N
svg.title: Indian States
svg.desc: DataMeet India community / Election Commission of India, via geoBoundaries gbOpen IND ADM1 (9469f09). CC BY 2.5 IN — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/in/. English display names, Albers projection, coordinate rounding, shared-border SVG and thumbnail conversion, and enlarged click circles for small regions. 28 states and 8 union territories. Islands remain in geographic position. Dashed circles enlarge small targets. Boundaries follow the source and do not resolve territorial disputes.
